about: Trigger-rate eval corpus for the Kademi skills. Each query names the one skill that should fire; should_trigger false means no Kademi skill should fire. Split 60/40 into train and validation - use train to guide a description change, validation only to choose between candidates. Run it with scripts/trigger-evals.md.
scoring: Three runs per query. A positive passes above a 0.5 trigger rate, a negative at or below.
coverage_gaps: kademi-rewards, kademi-commerce and kademi-coding-standards have one positive each and none in validation; kademi-ai and kademi-api-reference have two. Add two or three positives each before tuning those descriptions. kademi-ksync was added after the two recorded runs, so neither run covers it.
